# Implement engineering package

- Inspect the repository state, PROJECT_MANIFEST.md, CURRENT_STATUS.md, ROADMAP.md, and the assigned Engineering Package file before editing.
- Implement only the assigned engineering package and avoid unrelated changes.
- Add or update tests for the package behavior.
- Run the complete validation sequence before finishing.
- Do not commit or push changes.
- End with a structured implementation report that summarizes the work, files touched, validation results, and any follow-up items.
- Consult the Project Intelligence documents for current status, roadmap, metrics, and decisions before making changes.
